title: What the Paradise Riflebird wears

is_this_you.pressure: Under fire you stand straighter. The coat stays buttoned, and nobody sees what it costs to keep it that way.
is_this_you.love: You court in one burst, wings up, head back. Then you need your own branch again.
is_this_you.cost: You show up brilliantly for the courtship. The long work of the nest can end up in someone else's hands.

opener.text: Somebody looked at this bird and saw a soldier. The name riflebird is said to come from the male's black velvet plumage, which recalled the dark uniform of the British Army's Rifle Brigade [s5] [s7]. The Australian Museum adds an honest “allegedly” [s7]. You were born a Leo in a Horse year. You came dressed for parade.

tabs.label: Your uniform
tabs.intro: Fire on Fire, buttoned into black.

rows.text: Leo is fixed Fire, ruled by the Sun, a sign that woos with extravagance and holds its ground [s1] [s2]. The Horse is yang Fire, lively and frank, and it dislikes taking orders [s3] [s4]. That is the same element twice. You carry a great deal of heat under a severe coat.

The male's black feathers soak up almost all the light that hits them [s9]. Across his crown, throat and belly runs a green and blue sheen that shimmers as the sun moves [s6] [s8]. Most days people see the soldier. Catch you at the right moment and the metal shows.

Riflebirds live above 500 metres in summer and come down below 200 in winter [s5] [s7]. The Horse in you needs that kind of range. Keep a high post and a low one, and move between them when the season turns.

tabs.label: The display
tabs.intro: One branch. One burst. Then the ridge.

rows.text: He shows off from a traditional perch, usually a thick bare branch high in the canopy [s7] [s8]. Both wings go up and curve over his head [s6]. You also have one place you perform from. Anywhere else, you are just passing through.

To make that circle of wings, riflebirds bend the wrist back far beyond any other known bird [s10] [s11]. The bird that was filmed was a Victoria's riflebird, a close cousin [s11]. Your big moments look easy. They cost more than anyone on the ground can see.
The call is one loud, explosive hiss, a “yaassss” about two seconds long [s6] [s5]. Leo has a dramatic streak [s2]. You say it once, at full volume, and then the matter is closed.

China Highlights lists performer and tour operator among Horse careers [s4]. Add Leo's stage and you fit product launches, live events and field guiding. Give yourself one big reveal a season, then the next ridge.

tabs.label: Who you open your wings for
tabs.intro: Three who hold the line with you. One who breaks rank.
tabs.love_lead: In love you court in one dazzling move, the way Leo is said to [s2]. The Horse prizes honesty and loyalty [s4]. You need someone who keeps a branch of their own and does not ask you to stand still. Three of the old pairings march beside you.

easy.why: The Lanner Falcon (Sagittarius, Tiger year) shares your trine of Tiger, Horse and Dog, and Sagittarius is Fire like you [s3] [s1].
The Giant Otter (Aries, Dog year) completes that trine, and Aries makes the third Fire sign [s3] [s1].
The Rock Wren (Gemini, Goat year) is your secret friend, since the Goat is the Horse's Six Harmonies partner [s3].

hard.why: The one who breaks rank is the Sonoran Desert Toad (Aquarius, Rat year): the Rat clashes with the Horse, and Aquarius sits opposite Leo [s3] [s1].

story.text: He does none of the nesting. Only the female builds the nest and tends it [s7]. She drapes cast-off snake skins over the rim, and nobody knows why, though one guess is that they scare off nest robbers [s8].

closing: Let them salute the coat. Save the snake skins for the nest, where your people sleep.
